body:
### Summary

Hey Astra team

The S3 preview feature is great!
I would like to make my humble requets to include support for AWS_PROFILE, AWS_DEFAULT_PROFILE and SSO based token refresh.

Currently how we work around this:

```bash
export UV_S3_ENDPOINT_URL=https://<bucket>.s3.<region>.amazonaws.com
aws sso login
eval "$(AWS_PROFILE=TheProfile aws configure export-credentials --format env)"
uv sync
```

I propose this API change

```toml
# pypropject.toml
[[tool.uv.index]]
name = "internal"
url = "https://<bucket>.s3.<region>.amazonaws.com/simple"
signing = "s3"
```

```bash
# uv picks up {AWS_DEFAULT_PROFILE,AWS_PROFILE}
# issues the SSO triggers the token refresh flow if necessary
uv sync
```

I can also implement this, though I'm sure you'll have some thoughts on the API design which might affect how to implement.

# Securite considerations

Under this proposal, uv will now issue AWS token refreshes. I beleive this is better compared to exporting those as shell variable.

Thanks for reading this,
Hope you'll like my proposal

Cheers
